objections.qa_reverify: Verified grep -cF semantics: -c counts matching lines, -F treats pattern as fixed-string (avoids regex interpretation of brackets in '[deployStampCheck]'). All three substrings ('[deployStampCheck] FAIL', '[deployStampCheck] FAIL: drift detected', 'REFUSED: rednote-mcp must not be installed via npm') are quoted from architect prescription literal text and are load-bearing signals. The substring approach correctly bypasses both bash-quote-fragility and npm-exit-wrapping. AC8's STDERR_OUT capture pattern correctly separates stderr (2>&1) from stdout (1>/dev/null) so JSON-RPC frames don't pollute the substring grep.
